title: Characterization of the kth smallest value
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered set and let $l$ be a list of distinct elements of $\alpha$. For a natural number $k$ and $y\in\alpha$, the value $y$ satisfies the defining rank conditions for being the $k$th smallest element of $l$ if and only if $y$ occurs in $l$ and exactly $k$ entries of $l$ are at most $y$.
